model_organism.citation: Thalamocortical transcriptional gates coordinate memory stabilization (PMID: 41299170)
phenotypes: Targeted CRISPR knockout of Tcf4 in the thalamocortical circuit had no effect on memory formation
Impaired memory maintenance/stabilization over weeks (late-phase memory)
Tcf4 acts in a CAMTA1-TCF4-ASH1L transcriptional cascade; CAMTA1 is needed for early maintenance, TCF4 and ASH1L for later maintenance

model_organism.citation: scRNA sequencing uncovers a TCF4-dependent transcription factor network regulating commissure development in mouse (PMID: 34184026)
phenotypes: Tcf4 acts in Satb2+ intercortical projection neurons
TCF4 and SOX11 interact biochemically and cooperatively control commissure formation in vivo (interhemispheric connectivity)
Altered transcription of genes implicated in commissure formation

model_organism.citation: Rescue of behavioral and electrophysiological phenotypes in a Pitt-Hopkins syndrome mouse model by genetic restoration of Tcf4 expression (PMID: 35535852)
model_organism.knockout_type: conditional knockout (Tcf4 conditional allele with postnatal restoration of expression)
phenotypes: Postnatal reinstatement of neuronal Tcf4 improved anxiety-like behavior, activity, innate behaviors and memory, partially corrected EEG abnormalities and gene expression

model_organism.citation: Tcf4 dysfunction alters dorsal and ventral cortical neurogenesis in Pitt-Hopkins syndrome mouse model showing sexual dimorphism (PMID: 38636614)
phenotypes: Altered dynamics of cortical progenitors from the earliest stages of cortex formation
Altered neuronal populations and cortical layering at birth
Defective layering of pyramidal neurons, partially rescued by in utero electroporation of TCF4
Defective ventral generation of interneurons, suggesting an excitation/inhibition imbalance
Sexual dimorphism, with more marked effects in males than females

model_organism.citation: Transcription factors TCF4 and KLF4 respectively control the development of the DC2A and DC2B lineages (PMID: 40702338)
phenotypes: Siglec-H+CD115- pre-DC2s give rise to CD7+CD11blo DC2A cells in a TCF4-dependent manner
Tcf4 conditional deletion affects DC2A lineage development

model_organism.citation: CD44 functions in Wnt signaling by regulating LRP6 localization and activation (PMID: 25301071)
model_organism.knockout_type: other (knockdown of CD44, not tcf-4; tcf-4 is a downstream readout)
phenotypes: CD44 morphants show decreased expression of the Wnt targets tcf-4 and en-2 in the developing brain

biological.citation: Zic2 paper - Transcription factor Zic2 inhibits Wnt/β-catenin protein signaling (PMID: 21908606)
biological.summary: ZIC2 binds directly to the HMG box DNA-binding domain of TCF4 through its zinc finger domain and inhibits β-catenin·TCF4 transcriptional activity without changing TCF4 DNA binding. In Xenopus, Zic2 blocked β-catenin-induced axis duplication and Wnt target induction.

biological.citation: Isoform-Specific Expression and Feedback Regulation of E Protein TCF4 Control Dendritic Cell Lineage Specification (PMID: 27986456)
biological.summary: TCF4 (E2-2) has two transcript isoforms, and the long isoform is expressed specifically in pDCs. Deleting it in mice impaired pDC development and expanded non-canonical CD8+ cDCs. A conserved downstream enhancer drives Tcf4 upregulation through a positive feedback loop and is sensitive to BET inhibition.

biological.citation: Aberrant expression and function of TCF4 in the proliferation of hepatocellular carcinoma cell line BEL-7402 (PMID: 15040893)
biological.summary: TCF4 mRNA is higher in HCC line BEL-7402 than in normal liver line L02. Dominant-negative ΔNTCF4 suppressed BEL-7402 growth and reduced cyclin D1 and c-myc, whereas stabilized β-catenin S37A increased proliferation. Neither treatment affected L02 cells.

biological.citation: Circ-DENND4C up-regulates TCF4 expression to modulate hepatocellular carcinoma cell proliferation and apoptosis via activating Wnt/β-catenin signal pathway (PMID: 32669971)
biological.summary: Circ-DENND4C sponges miR-195-5p to increase TCF4 expression and activate Wnt/β-catenin signaling in HCC cells. Rescue assays showed that TCF4 mediates the circRNA's pro-tumor effects in vitro and in vivo.

biological.citation: Differential LEF1 and TCF4 expression is involved in melanoma cell phenotype switching (PMID: 21599871)
biological.summary: TCF4 is preferentially expressed in dedifferentiated/invasive melanoma cells, inversely to LEF1, which marks proliferative cells. Knockdown showed TCF4 and LEF1 are needed for phenotype-specific expression of M-MITF and WNT5A, and LEF1 suppresses TCF4 expression independently of β-catenin.

biological.citation: Rescue of behavioral and electrophysiological phenotypes in a Pitt-Hopkins syndrome mouse model by genetic restoration of Tcf4 expression (PMID: 35535852)
biological.summary: In a conditional Tcf4 mouse model of PTHS, postnatal reinstatement of Tcf4 in neurons improved anxiety-like behavior, activity, innate behaviors and memory. It also partially corrected EEG abnormalities and the expression of TCF4-regulated genes, which supports haploinsufficiency as the disease mechanism.

biological.citation: Intrinsic properties of Tcf1 and Tcf4 splice variants determine cell-type-specific Wnt/β-catenin target gene expression (PMID: 22859735)
biological.summary: In embryonic stem cells, induction of a subset of Wnt/β-catenin targets requires Tcf1 and Tcf4, acting mainly through C-clamp-containing Tcf4E splice variants. Combined Tcf1/Tcf4 knockdown abolished Wnt-inducible transcription but did not change the active chromatin state of targets.

biological.citation: UHRF2 promotes intestinal tumorigenesis through stabilization of TCF4 mediated Wnt/β-catenin signaling (PMID: 32372448)
biological.summary: Uhrf2 directly interacts with and SUMOylates Tcf4, which stabilizes it and sustains oncogenic Wnt/β-catenin signaling in intestinal tumors. Uhrf2 loss in ApcMin mice inhibited tumorigenesis.

biological.citation: The TCF4/β-catenin pathway and chromatin structure cooperate to regulate D-glucuronyl C5-epimerase expression in breast cancer (PMID: 22805760)
biological.summary: GLCE is a target of the TCF4/β-catenin complex in breast cancer cells. TSA or 5-aza-dC/TSA treatment increased the interaction of TCF4/β-catenin with the GLCE promoter, and GLCE expression correlated with TCF4 and β-catenin in cells and primary tumors. Ectopic TCF4/β-catenin alone was insufficient, so chromatin structure also matters.

In cord blood cells, TCF4 overexpression doubled erythroid CFU-Es and TCF4 knockdown sharply decreased erythroid colonies. Both manipulations inhibited megakaryocyte colonies. TCF4 mRNA is lower in HSCs, CMPs and MEPs from MDS patients, and higher TCF4 correlates with higher hemoglobin.
biological.significance: p=0.02 (hemoglobin, high vs low TCF4 in MDS)
